You can download and install an apache webserver which is what runs the vast majority of websites for free. Once you get it setup you can then connect to your new webserver through either the special domain "localhost" or the special ip 127.0.0.1 (which redirects to your own machine). Web hosts will offer some little tools like the ability to setup a forum with a few clicks or whatever, but in general you can test everything locally easier, faster, and for free.
